newsitem.title: USA: World Acceptance Q2 hurt by two factors.
newsitem.headline: World Acceptance Q2 hurt by two factors.

text.p: World Acceptance Corp said Tuesday its second quarter results were hurt by slower-than-normal growth in loans and a continued increase in the level of loan charge-offs.

World Acceptance Chairman and Chief Executive Charles Walters said in a statement that although the results were "somewhat less than the company's historical performance record, they were not surprising in view of the condition of the overall consumer segment of the financial services industry."
At September 30, 1996, gross loans outstanding were $107.7 million compared with $97.5 million for the same period in the prior year.
Its provision for loan losses stood at $3.03 million for the quarter compared with $2.5 million in the 1995 second quarter.
Walters added that the company is optimistic that the upcoming quarter will show loan growth.
